results.natural_query: Show me all customers who have placed orders in the last 30 days with their order details
results.sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.email, c.city, c.country, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.total_amount, o.status, o.shipping_address
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_date >= DATE('now', '-30 days')
ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, c.customer_name;

results.natural_query: Find the top 5 best-selling products by total quantity sold
results.sql:
SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity_sold
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC
LIMIT 5;

results.natural_query: List all orders with customer names for orders above $1000
results.sql:
SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.total_amount, c.customer_name
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.total_amount > 1000
ORDER BY o.order_date DESC;

results.natural_query: Get the average order value by customer city
results.sql:
SELECT c.city, AVG(o.total_amount) AS average_order_value
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.city
ORDER BY average_order_value DESC;

results.natural_query: Show products that are low in stock (less than 30 items) with their supplier information
results.sql:
SELECT p.product_name, p.category, p.price, p.stock_quantity, s.supplier_name, s.country
FROM products p
JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
WHERE p.stock_quantity < 30
ORDER BY p.stock_quantity ASC;

results.natural_query: Find customers who have spent more than $1500 total across all their orders
results.sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.email, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.email
HAVING total_spent > 1500
ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

results.natural_query: Display the total revenue generated by each product category
results.sql:
SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

results.natural_query: Show suppliers and count how many products they supply, ordered by product count
results.sql:
SELECT s.supplier_name, s.country, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count
FROM suppliers s
JOIN products p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, s.country
ORDER BY product_count DESC;

results.natural_query: Find all orders that contain products from multiple suppliers
results.sql:
SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.supplier_id) AS supplier_count
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_date, o.customer_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.supplier_id) > 1
ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.order_id;

results.natural_query: List the most recent order for each customer with product details
results.sql:
SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.total_amount, c.customer_id, c.customer_name, p.product_id, p.product_name, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price, oi.discount
FROM customers c
JOIN (
    SELECT customer_id, MAX(order_date) AS max_order_date
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
) mo ON c.customer_id = mo.customer_id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.order_date = mo.max_order_date
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
ORDER BY c.customer_id, o.order_date DESC;

results.natural_query: Show which products have never been ordered
results.sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.category, p.price, p.stock_quantity
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE oi.product_id IS NULL
ORDER BY p.product_name;

results.natural_query: Find customers who have ordered from the Electronics category more than twice
results.sql:
SELECT c.customer_name, c.email, COUNT(*) AS electronics_orders
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.category = 'Electronics'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.email
HAVING COUNT(*) > 2
ORDER BY electronics_orders DESC;
